podcast.body: Released a few months ahead of the album of the same name, this song was initially featured on the soundtrack to the TV show "The Last Panthers." Its accompanying surreal 10-minute music video depicted a woman discovering a dead astronaut and featured Bowie himself appearing as both a spirit in the clouds holding a Bible-like book and a "rath" with bandages and buttons over his eyes, setting a profound tone for his final album. "A few months ahead of the album, a song called Blackstar was released via the soundtrack to a TV show called The Last Panthers."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: The song from Bowie's final album of the same name, the video for which was being filmed when he received his terminal cancer diagnosis. It is suggested that the song and video contain hidden messages about his death. "Go through the song and video, and you might find some messages that Bowie, knowing that he was dying, left behind."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
